issues.title: Acceptance Criteria are meta-tests, not functional tests
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-08 verify the existence and naming of markdown files (spec hygiene) rather than the behavior of the PowerShell script (e.g., 'Given a missing Go installation, When run, Then winget installs Go').
issues.fix: Add GWT scenarios for core logic: dependency bootstrapping, PnP fallback logic, and firewall rule injection.

issues.title: Concurrency and Process Locking unaddressed
issues.why: The script performs recursive deletions and file moves (Step 5) but does not address cases where files are locked by a running backend or an IDE, which is a common failure point in PowerShell dev-loops.
issues.fix: Add a 'Stop-ExistingProcess' function that kills processes bound to the configured ports before cleaning/copying.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'rootDir' resolution
issues.why: The spec states paths are relative to the script location, but 'rootDir' in the JSON can also be relative. If rootDir is '../', the interaction with backendDir/frontendDir resolution is not explicitly typed.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that all other paths are joined to the resolved absolute path of rootDir.
